newsitem.title: FRANCE: Lamassoure plans to lift limits on savings plans.
newsitem.headline: Lamassoure plans to lift limits on savings plans.

text.p: The French government plans to promote consumption by offering certain savers early interest payments on popular savings plans to give the economy a boost, government spokesman Alain Lamassoure said on Wednesday.
Lamassoure said the lifting of restrictions would release about 15 billion francs.
"It has been decided to offer immediately non-tax paying savers interest earned on popular savings plans," said Lamassoure at a news conference. -- Paris Newsroom +331 4221 5542
